platform: Focus School Software: hybrid, web-based K–12 SIS and ERP with SaaS/AWS and customer-hosted deployment options.

distinctive_features.feature: Extensive U.S. state reporting with validation, verification, corrections, and upload-ready extracts.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can manage jurisdiction-specific submissions and data corrections within the SIS.

distinctive_features.feature: Elementary scheduling optimization and secondary schedule-building scenarios.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can test constraints and distribute students or course sections before finalizing schedules.

distinctive_features.feature: Assessment supports 52 item types and IEP-linked text-to-speech accommodations.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can create varied assessments and apply documented accommodations in delivery.

distinctive_features.feature: What-if enrollment projections use five years of history and can incorporate county population projections.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: District leaders can use enrollment scenarios for forward planning.

distinctive_features.feature: Form Builder and workflow triggers support validations, approvals, e-signatures, and alerts.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can configure forms and processes around local administrative requirements.

distinctive_features.feature: Communications can automatically translate messages into more than 70 languages.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can communicate with families across many language groups.

distinctive_features.feature: Unified SIS and ERP share a login, interface, and database.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Student, finance, HR, and payroll workflows operate within one platform.

distinctive_features.feature: Attendance kiosk and mobile scanner support sign-in, tardies, and printed slips.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can extend attendance workflows to physical check-in and tardy operations.

weaknesses.issue: District SIS/ERP pricing is quote-only, with no public subscription baseline.
Reviewers report crashes, slowness, or intermittent outages; some say downtime may be district-specific.
Users describe cluttered or dated navigation, many clicks, and limited screen personalization.
Teachers report feature-discovery, training, and support gaps; reviewers cite difficulty printing report cards.
Native transport, library, hostel, alumni, and fundraising modules are not documented; some functions rely on integrations.
Public materials do not establish SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification or GDPR/DPDP compliance.

ai_features: No production generative-AI assistant or copilot is documented.
What-if Analysis projects enrollment using historical data and optional county population projections; it is described as statistical, not AI.
pricing_model_summary: District SIS/ERP pricing is quote-only; no public subscription rate card, per-student rate, or implementation fee is documented. Attendance hardware has separate listed prices.
biggest_strategic_gap: Several adjacent functions—including transport, library, hostel, alumni, and fundraising—lack documented native modules, while AI-assistant capabilities are absent.
